title: Fast rising Hip Hop Duo Flyana Boss is making waves with their recent track “Really Really”.
htmlContent:
Emerging hip-hop duo Flyana Boss has made a name for itself in the music scene. Hailing from Detroit and Dallas, respectively, these two women took time to learn about their craft, and they have turned their raw musical genius into a flossy, irresistible package that will make you thirsty for more. These attributes are on full display in the release of their latest track, "Really Really."

Flyana Boss' "Really Really" is a tongue-in-cheek act of reclamation. The vocal performance of this track is daring with a signature style that grabs you instantly, and they deliver their amazing lyrics with masterful precision that makes this song a true gem. "Really Really" is a modern dating anthem that glorifies setting boundaries and vibing on your own that keeps their fans coming back for more.
